_comment: Job_Sex dispatches SexScene_EndSummary once per completed participation record, not once per partner or per displayed line. Rejoining opens a fresh record and may settle again without reusing prior facts. sex_summary_participation identifies this character's participation number within the scene. These are historical facts, not new permission, consent, an orgasm quota, or a request to replay acts. Larger rewards and personality-specific outcomes may be authored later; this event grants no stats, relationships, or XP. Offscreen, exhausted, sleeping, and unconscious NPCs remain eligible; execution is independent of normal visibility and never forces an offscreen display.
_comment_targets: Keep the injected targets unchanged: self is the actual departed character; partners is the actual interacted list and may be empty; participants is the historical roster. Do not scope by current room, generate targets, inject the player, or require partners to exist. Text names only self and assigns no body roles.
_comment_inputs: True-only AppendStrings keys: sex_summary_hadActs, sex_summary_hadPleasure, sex_summary_hadPain, sex_summary_hadClimax, sex_summary_forcedContext, sex_summary_wasForced, sex_summary_victimAtEntry, sex_summary_aggressorAtEntry, sex_summary_victimAtExit, sex_summary_aggressorAtExit, sex_summary_noActs, sex_summary_entryKnown. False flags are absent. Invariant numeric single-string keys: sex_summary_sceneRef, sex_summary_roomRef, sex_summary_participation, sex_summary_minutes, sex_summary_entryLust, sex_summary_acts (sex commands only; gentle in-scene touch commands are not acts), sex_summary_pleasure (pleasure gained, before pain's deduction), sex_summary_pleasureLostToPain (the part of it pain took away), sex_summary_pain, sex_summary_climaxes. Lists: sex_summary_comIDs, sex_summary_comTags (command tags), sex_summary_categories (command categoryTags, eg. com_category_v). CompareAppendNumber takes exactly [key, op, value]; supported operators are eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte. Legacy active scenes have unknown entry/history, so do not infer nothing happened before observation began.
_comment_duplicatePolicy: Allow queued summaries to overlap in self and targets: another participation or scene may end before an earlier summary finishes. Each record's persisted settlement guard prevents duplicate publication; a global event cooldown must not discard a new participation's frozen summary.
_comment_kojoExtension: Stable reaction labels: relieved, forcedAftermath, painful, satisfied, contentNonpenetrative, unsatisfied, neutral; all converge on finish. These are provisional initial-presentation rules, not universal personality judgments or C# classifications. A future authored GetKojoEntry fetch branch or premade NPC override can be inserted before a reaction Line, with a fallback to that Line; no Kojo scaffolding is implemented now. Pleasure or climax does not imply consent or erase a forced aftermath. contentNonpenetrative is a stable presentation label, not an inference about which acts occurred.

events.label: start
events._comment: Ordered first-success routing. Results contain only checks AND JumpToLabel, never effects: Results do not short-circuit. Keep any future effects on separate destination Lines.

zh-cn.SexScene_EndSummary_relieved: 对$self.name$而言，至少这次没有再发生什么，紧绷感终于有了消退的余地。
zh-cn.SexScene_EndSummary_forcedAftermath: $self.name$所经历的强迫已经停止，留下的不适却不会因此一笔勾销。
zh-cn.SexScene_EndSummary_painful: 余下的疼痛让$self.name$难以轻松下来。
zh-cn.SexScene_EndSummary_satisfied: $self.name$的身体在余韵中渐渐平复，先前的紧绷暂时得到了缓解。
zh-cn.SexScene_EndSummary_contentNonpenetrativ: $self.name$留着一点舒适的余韵，这一刻还算平和。
zh-cn.SexScene_EndSummary_unsatisfied: 对$self.name$而言，先前的期待还悬着，身体的躁意也没有完全消退。
zh-cn.SexScene_EndSummary_neutral: 对$self.name$而言，这一段暂且告一段落。
